strategy.label: transcription drafted from the report excerpt by the LLM pipeline (reverse-bafu draft)
strategy.note: basis: Fig. 4.1 'Flows for "sanitary ceramics, at regional storage" and its representation in the ecoinvent database' [CH], per 1 kg; allocation: none stated. Review every derivation; unreviewed entries have reviewed_by = null.

gaps_reported_by_model: The continuation page of Fig. 4.1 (outputs part 2) is blank in the text extraction, so the DIRECT EMISSIONS to air and water of ceramic production (dust, fluorides, waste-water loads) could not be read - only the waste flows of part 1 are available.
No waste-water treatment input appears although 0.541 kg of tap water and 10.6 l of well water are consumed.
Several output lines ('paper', 'gypsum', 'clay suspension') are marked as recycled without an assigned ecoinvent module, so they carry no burden here.
skipped_items: Water, well, in ground: no flow chosen (The keyword search returned no candidate for well water in ground, so nothing can be chosen; the line is reported as missing.)

recycled production waste: ignore — internal loop: 'internally recycled (substitutes feldspar)'; the same 8.97E-02 kg appears once as an input from in-house production and once as an output, so the two cancel.
paper, recycled: ignore — 'recycled', no disposal dataset assigned in the table
gypsum, recycled in cement plants: ignore — 'recycled in cement plants', no dataset assigned
clay suspension, recycled in brick fabrication: ignore — 'recycled in brick fabrication', no dataset assigned
